description: The stretch of the Kremlin's red-brick wall on the Vasilyevsky Spusk side, down to the Beklemishevskaya Tower and round the corner on the river between the Constantine and Helen Tower and the Peter's Tower, built 1485-1495 by Italian masters, and on round the Beklemishevskaya Tower to Peter's Tower on the river.
